question: The graph of an inverse proportional function passes through the point \((-2,3)\). Which of the following points also lies on its graph?
solution: \(k=-2\times3=-6\). Check the product of the coordinates of each point: A gives 6, B gives 6, C gives \(-6\), and D gives 6. Only the product for C equals \(-6\).
